newsitem.title: USA: Trak Auto Q4 Feb 1 sales were $80.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Trak Auto Q4 Feb 1 sales were $80.6 mln.

text.p: Trak Auto Corp said on Tuesday its sales for the quarter ended February 1 were $80,563,000, down 8.5 percent from the $87,898 it reported for the same period a year ago, and same-store sales were down 6.9 percent.
But the company said the decline was primarily due to the extra week of sales included in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
Sales for the 52-week year increased to $345,960,000, compared with $342,242,000 for the 53 weeks ended Feb. 3, 1996.
Same-store sales for fiscal 1997 decreased 1.7 percent.

The increase in total sales for fiscal 1997 was attributable to the company's entry into the Pittsburgh market in January 1996, and to increased sales in the Washington D.C. and Chicago markets during the first quarter as a result of harsh winter conditions.
